essence: Proper ritual preparation requires three breath-controls and the prescribed placement.
After offering arghya and foot-water, one should give the tooth-cleansing implement.
A pure and auspicious cloth should be given for wiping the hands and face.
One should visualize the venerable teacher there as camphor-like and in divine form.
The left-seated figure is radiant red and holds a playful lotus in the left hand.
